neighbours.label: Web-page clutter breaking into article text, read at its first token: a line-opening media or section label such as 'Image', 'Photo', 'Video', 'Related' or 'Advertisement' (a capitalised 'Image' fires even when it opens an ordinary sentence), or a '...' that cuts a word off before a 'Read More' / '[continues]' link. Quiet: lowercase image/photo/video inside a sentence, ordinary storytelling ellipses, and plain prose lines.
